name: beyond-nations
title: Beyond Nations
description: a 3D colony-and-nations game: gather, found settlements, lead a nation through eras, and deal with neighbours
cheats: Do not press F1-F6 (debug overlay and spawn commands) or use `--stage-*` switches unless your goal says so.

smoke.description: Title -> Start -> Begin -> walk to trees and chop until the Gather wood objective completes

goals.goal: Play the first 10 minutes as a brand-new player who has never seen the game; note every moment of confusion.
Reach the Village era as fast as you can (it cannot come before day 3, about 17 minutes of game time); record the game time of every objective.
Survive the first winter. Start with `--season autumn` (a fresh world otherwise reaches winter only after about 57 minutes of game time). Note how food and cold feel.
Diplomacy and war: lead a nation, meet a neighbour, try alliance, rivalry and war from the Nations screen (O).
Trade and caravans: build a market stall, buy and sell, get a Storehouse and send a caravan.
Ruler, laws and heirs: lead a nation, enact and repeal laws, and see what happens when the ruler dies.
Crafting: find and use every recipe on the crafting screen (C); are tools worth making?
World events: play until world events are offered, take different choices, and judge whether the consequences are clear and fair.

Accessibility and text audit, touching only what a mouse-and-keyboard player would: every screen and panel; cut-off, overlapping, unclear or misspelled text; contrast; anything only explained on hover.

Save/load and share-seed round trip: save from the pause menu, stop, `pt start --continue`, confirm the world is identical; then start a new world from the seed shown on the Share screen and confirm it matches.
